content.text: I need to investigate tenant spending in September. Let me query the margin data to see what happened.

input.sql:
SELECT 
  margin_date,
  tenant_id,
  ai_revenue_usd,
  llm_cost_usd,
  cost_to_serve_usd,
  request_count,
  feature_scope
FROM fct_tenant_margin
WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM margin_date) = 9
ORDER BY margin_date, tenant_id
LIMIT 200
